column1: #   protoshade   the .bin the editor produces. A data partition
#                can map it into the address space and the packed images cost no RAM.
#                2 MB holds a program with several 512x512 images in it.
#   spiffs       the editor itself (npm run build:device -> data/)
#                It has to be called "spiffs": Arduino's LittleFS.begin() looks for that
